the development of an object-oriented data and query processing model, which is suitable for large image bases.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a formal data model for image databases must explicitly represent the representation dependent spatial information.
the data model should be able to handle both generic and representation dependent attributes in a uniform fashion.

the distinction between generic and representation-dependent spatial attributes, and the explicit representation of the representation level, are important for content and similarity based image retrieval.
